name: sinua-repo-lint
description: The repo's TypeScript lint gate and nothing else. This is a Cargo-rooted workspace: the eleven npm installs under apps/ and packages/ each own their own dependencies, and this manifest deliberately has no `workspaces` field so it changes nothing about how they resolve. It exists only because ESLint 9 resolves plugins relative to its config file, so eslint.config.mjs and its node_modules have to live together.
//lint:fix: `lint:fix` is scoped to this seat's own areas and must stay scoped. A repo-wide `eslint . --fix` rewrote four files across three other seats on 2026-09-20 and broke packages/web's build: --fix rewrites WARNINGS too, and no-unnecessary-type-assertion gives a different verdict from the repo root than from inside a package, because type-aware results depend on which tsconfig and which node_modules are in play. Never run a fix tool repo-wide in a shared tree.
